summary: Missing invariant (seeded): `loop $grow` lost its fact sq_le(r, n) (line 30), so at the loop head nothing says r² ≤ n. Both exits of block $done owe is_isqrt(r, n) = r² ≤ n < (r+1)², and neither can show the first half: two runtime-checked cups, $isqrt not VERIFIED. The loop-entry and back-edge cups disappear with the invariant. The code is correct, so runs pass.

cups.goal: $is_isqrt(ext_u(#r), ext_u($n)) at the taken edge (#r = loop-head φ)
cups.why: First exit (u(r) ≥ 65535): the relevant facts are r ≤ 65535 (the local's type) and the edge fact; nothing says r² ≤ n, and with r = 65535 and n = 0 the first half of is_isqrt fails.

cups.why: Second exit ((r+1)² > n): the edge fact gives the second half of is_isqrt, but nothing relates r² to n. §3 treats the monomial r² as its own unknown, so it can choose r² > n; the countermodel it prints (n = 0, r = 0) lists only the program values, not that unknown.
